sentence: Fui the auriche you cannot carry without borrowing someone else's room.

wombos.definition: A highly specific, niche-flavored aura — the distinct presence someone carries that belongs to a very particular aesthetic or subculture.
wombos.example: Her whole fit gave off this very specific auriche that only a few people would even recognize.

wombos.definition: An expression of disapproval directed at someone displaying unsolicited, overbearing, or inappropriate attraction toward another person — a sharper, more dismissive version of Oui.
wombos.example: He would not stop staring, so I just looked over and said, 'Fui.'
